text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet approves recommendations to develop prisons. Kuwait's Central Prison has been plauged in recent weeks by fueding among inmates and riots demanding an ease in security measures.
- Kuwaitis are the highest consumers of potable water in the world, Ministry of Electricity and Water report says.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah approves parliamentary re-elections in one constituency on Februery 19 after Constitutional Court found inconsistency in October's poll.
- Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah says Kuwait's democracy wins international admiration. Kuwait is the only Gulf Arab state with an elected parliament.

- Head of parliament's financial committee Nasser al-Sanea says Kuwait Finance House is willing to participate in providing housing for citizens. The state is obliged by law to provide accommodation for Kuwaiti families.
- MP calls to ease conditions on family reunion entry visas.
